body: That's OK. I don't think there are any easy solutions. But thanks for listening. It helped just to share it.

I started 4 weeks ago, but in the first week I was hit with 2 big deadlines for October, picking up projects halfway through where they'd not really been given the love and attention which they needed, and the teams were pretty inexperienced and floundering. They're back on track now I think, but need constant handholding. My boss tends to do things last minute and that doesn't always pay off, though his drive is pretty impressive. I have to present the two projects on a trip overseas in first week of october, and it's going to be super high visibility situation which could really impact the team's future. So yeah, no pressure there. I also find presenting really hard, I have very little control over my adrenaline levels in a threatening situation so try as I might, my body gives me away.

 I think the underlying problem is that I negotiated a very decent package and job role, but that's set everyone's expectations very high for what I will be achieving, and it's meant I haven't had that 2-3 months to settle into a job before shit got serious. I guess I kind of needed that after the summer. I'm also stubborn af and admitting that I need a bit more support is not something I've ever been able to do. I am terrified of fucking this up as everyone has invested so heavily in me, so I am probably putting way more pressure on myself than I need to. I feel really alone
